description: This file defines the LoanInterestRecalculationData class, a data transfer object (DTO) used to encapsulate data related to loan interest recalculation settings in the Fineract project. It includes properties for various interest recalculation parameters, calendars, frequencies, and options, along with constructors and chainable setters.

classes.name: LoanInterestRecalculationData
classes.description: A DTO class representing loan interest recalculation configurations, parameters, and associated calendar data, with constructors and chainable setters.

methods.name: LoanInterestRecalculationData
methods.description: Constructor to initialize all properties of the DTO with provided values.

methods.name: withCalendarData
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated CalendarData and compounding CalendarData, using the chainable setter pattern.
